{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling commas
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for loyal customers
target_df = sales_df[sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal']

# Compute the number of loyal customers and number who converted
n_loyal = len(target_df)
n_converted = target_df['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = n_converted / n_loyal

# Print the computed values
n_loyal, n_converted, conversion_rate"}
